Chocolate Syrup Brownies
By: Barnaby Dorfman
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 cup Sugar
1 stick margarine
4 Eggs
1 can chocolate syrup
1 cup Flour
Nuts if desired

Preparation

1 Cream together sugar and oleo. add eggs and beat well. add syrup and flour, mix well. add nuts if desired. spread on a well greased and floured cookie sheet. bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour. top with frosting or powder sugar.
